title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
ii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iii.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
iv.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
